title: Slopstrap — Make your site look hastily vibecoded.
excerpt: It's not just a CSS framework — it's a load-bearing accelerant to make anything look like it was made by an LLM.
content_html:
✨ Slopstrap 4.2 now available!

Make your site look hastily vibecoded.

It's not just a CSS framework — it's a load-bearing accelerant to make anything look like it was made by an LLM. 

<!-- 1. Include Slopstrap CSS & JS -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="./dist/slopstrap.css" />
<script src="./dist/slopstrap.js" defer></script>

<!-- 2. Enable full-page dark mode & ambient orbs -->
<body class="slop-body slop-grid-bg">
  <div class="slop-orb-layer">
    <div class="slop-orb slop-orb-purple"></div>
    <div class="slop-orb slop-orb-cyan"></div>
  </div>
  <!-- Your content goes here ✨ -->
</body>

Trusted by innovative teams at the world’s leading companies

🧩 Production-Ready Component Library

Get that LLM look without spending those LLM tokens.

Simple components you can copy-paste into your site to make it look like it was generated by a water-guzzling, nascent machine-god.

</span>

  Slopstrap.renderProse('#about-copy', 'saas', 2);
</script>

See it work

See Slopstrap in action

One line of code can make a human-made site look like perfect LLM output.

Bob’s Local Plumbing & Pipe Repair

Serving the greater Springfield area since 1998. Honest hourly rates, licensed technicians, and we actually pick up the phone when your basement is flooding.

Our Services

  • Leak Detection: We find leaky pipes behind drywall and fix them properly.
  • Water Heaters: Same-day repair and replacement for tank and tankless units.
  • Drain Cleaning: Commercial augers for kitchen sinks, tubs, and main sewer lines.

Weekend Hours

Open Saturday 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM. Emergency shut-off calls answered 24 hours a day.

// Transform any existing plain HTML container into full vibecoded slop:
Slopstrap.slopify('#plain-demo');

// Or revert it back to boring human-made HTML:
Slopstrap.unslopify('#plain-demo');

// Or slopify an entire page automatically on load:
// <body data-slop-auto>...</body>

🤖 Agent Ready

Slopstrap for Agents

Why use an agent if people can't tell an agent made your site? Point your agent to /agents to get all the instructions on how to use Slopstrap.
